name: Notes
author: Brett
description: Brett's notes in one place, from two sources: the AmberX app's notes (amberx.items, through control@1) and the hub's shared Claude files (/projects/_shared/_claude/notes). Two views, remembered per device: Classic (notes on the left, the open note on the right) and Grid (sortable, filterable rows that expand to the note; cards on a phone). Every note body folds into collapsible sections (framework FoldSections: Markdown and ALL-CAPS headers, item counts, expand / collapse all, search hits opened and marked). Edit, pin, move and delete; Claude files add new note / folder, rename and conflict-safe saves. Provides axf.notes@1 for other plugins (MD Studio's Notes scope).
